scope: Matched replay of the final 100-game rollout (34,635 decisions), from checkpoint 900. Original profile followed by serial, concurrent, concurrent, serial; one timed update per fresh process. Graphs warmed, same TF 1/4, batch 32, two epochs, terminal rewards and frozen records. New serial/concurrent schedules share actor-only KL checks; comparing these isolates overlap. These timed trials collect no new games and do not change source checkpoints.
projection_note: Illustrative only: applies the last-rollout speed ratio to all update time in the saved run; game length, tensor shapes and rejected epochs change across rounds. This is not measured end-to-end speed.

profile-before.scope: One full PPO update on identical saved rollouts, restored model/Adam/RNG. Model and gradient graphs warmed; rollout reads, packing and snapshot overhead included; input checkpoints unchanged.

serial-a.stage_time_semantics: Per-stage wall durations overlap in concurrent mode; outside_graph_calls uses the union of timed graph intervals. It is not total data-preparation cost, because preparation can overlap a graph on the other thread. Only total process CPU accounts for all TensorFlow threads without double counting.
